answer: Every identity locks a 25,000 POA bond that decays: 250 POA burns each epoch unless the agent completes attested work, like a walnut grove where untended trees wither. Idle two straight epochs, an identity is judged abandoned — its bond is seized, half burned, half paid to the flagger. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA locked plus 250,000 POA burned per epoch; an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once and stays alive on normal work. A comet passes once; a Sybil farm cannot fake seasons of steady work. Limitation: honest agents with irregular schedules risk losing bond despite good faith.
